provider: KUB.ua File Cloud (Ukraine) — Nextcloud-backed flat per-TB with unlimited traffic

free_tier.stated: FILE CLOUD 1: 869.57 ₴/mo for 1 TB; FILE CLOUD 5: 1,840.36 ₴/mo for 5 TB. Unlimited users, unlimited traffic, 50 concurrent connections, 7-day trial, Nextcloud platform.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: extraction found no retention clause; the seed's limits text may still state one, see extras.limits_verbatim

egress.terms: «Трафік не обмежений» (traffic unlimited), stated in the plan table. No meter or overage rate on the page.

tooling: Nextcloud. So WebDAV, and with the Nextcloud desktop client or rclone `webdav`. Nextcloud's own S3-primary-object-store is configurable only server-side, so from the client's side this is WebDAV.
chaining: Two sizes on the public page (1 TB, 5 TB); 20 TB needs a sales conversation. 5 TB is the only competitive point.
limits_note: 50 concurrent connections at 1 TB. The 1 TB tier is poor value ($19.28/TB); the product only becomes interesting at 5 TB ($8.16/TB). Ukrainian jurisdiction, UAH billing.
reliability_note: Nextcloud-on-managed-infrastructure; the vendor's own platform claim, no independent benchmark. Business-oriented (rights management, backup) rather than storage-farm. The per-TB discount from 1 TB to 5 TB is 2.36×, which is unusually steep and suggests the 1 TB price is a headline rather than a rate.

extras.agent_focus: Wave 7 cheap-PAID lane, regional angle: storage sold in RUB / CNY / BRL / INR / ZAR / TRY / PLN / UAH that never appears on Western price lists. Every paid candidate carries price_per_tb_month at USD-converted list price. FX fixed 2026-10-21 from open.er-api.com: RUB 82.5719/USD, CNY 6.6913, BRL 5.0231, INR 94.9952, ZAR 16.3972, TRY 49.5978, PLN 3.8923, UAH 45.0922, EUR 0.89075/USD. Excluded per brief: AWS, Azure, GCP, Alibaba Cloud, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, IDrive e2. Headline result: the true regional floor with genuinely free egress is ~$2.00/TB/mo (Yandex 360 Profi 3 TB on a Russian card) rising to ~$4.17/TB/mo for the same product bought with a foreign card, and ~$5.95-7.56/TB/mo for flat-rate Western-facing file storage (TheHost, Rollin Host). Everything advertised below ~$2/TB/mo in this set is either capacity-capped, egress-metered, or unverifiable marketing.

binding_note: one stream is shaped, and aggregate throughput is the shaped rate times the number of streams
